item.title: SCV 101: Elisabeth White & Jimmy Lifton, Worldwide Starship Foundation - SCVTV.com
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda sits down with Elisabeth White and Jimmy Lifton from the Worldwide Starship Foundation to tell us all about the organization and how they make it their mission to help neurodivergent individuals achieve their academic and professional aspirations and ultimately become self sufficient. They also talk about their very accomplished careers in the entertainment industry
